verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows Sumsub's biometric/liveness features (docs-12, docs-13) but contains no documentation addressing GDPR legal bases, BIPA or other US biometric statutes, or consent language guidance for legal review. Since Sumsub processes biometric data, this is a fair and applicable axis, but no evidence of such compliance documentation is present. Missing for 10: GDPR legal basis documentation, BIPA/US biometric statute guidance, consent language templates or legal review materials.
